text:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] Billing anomaly detected: token_aggregator count drift in eu-west-1. +25% burst vs 1h baseline, and delayed usage batches to accounting_queue. Overflagger triggered ~120 customers. Playbook: <https://redwood.internal/playbooks/billing-drift|billing-drift>
derek_oncall: ack — I'm on it. watching consumer-lag and emitter flush. paging billing eng @ben_billing :eyes:
ben_billing: on it, joining. seeing increased emitter flush_delay and some Kafka consumer rebalances since ~09:12UTC. will pull shadow vs live counts.
alice_sre: seeing emitter pods restart loop on eu cluster around 09:10. kube events show ephemeral volume attach timeouts. investigating node noisy IO.
ben_billing: quick query I'll run now to compare aggregates:
```sql
SELECT service, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, COUNT(*) AS events
FROM billing.events
WHERE ts >= '2025-04-08T09:00:00Z' AND ts < '2025-04-08T10:00:00Z'
GROUP BY service;
```
eva_recon: ran a shadow-aggregate (quick) — shadow pipeline shows ~18% fewer tokens for the same window vs live. backlog estimate ~3,100,000 tokens. logs:
```
kafka-consumer: partition=12 lag=1,234,567
emitter: flush_delay_ms=5200, flush_count=18
```
carla_support: any immediate customer impact? were overage emails sent already? I'll start drafting proactive comms for high-visibility accounts.
derek_oncall: mitigation steps: 1) suppressed automated overflagger (temp) 2) disabled nightly full-window job to avoid duplicate counts 3) kicked manual backfill job with limited concurrency 4) routing: set metering fallback to shadow for writes. Will update.
ben_billing: root cause hypothesis: emitter batching change in yesterday's deploy altered encoding causing occasional message drop on flush boundary. opened revert PR: <https://git.redwood/billing/pull/4123|pr-4123> — will try revert if hotfix needed.
alice_sre: scaling up consumers + rotating emitter pods in eu-west-1 now. ETA ~7m for pods to stabilize.
incidents-bot: Severity escalated to SEV2. Overflag suppression active. Incident channel opened.
frank_sales: flagged by partner: Acme got an overage email. can we get a quick list of impacted customers for RM outreach?
carla_support: list attached (12 accounts) — Acme, BetaApps, Clearview, and 9 others. I've created support tickets and a draft customer note (will share). assigning to CS lead.
eva_recon: running reconciliation script post-fix once deploy completes. will report delta and provide CSV of per-customer deltas.
derek_oncall: if we get drift <1% after backfill we'll close. please ping here when reconciliation finishes. keeping overflagging suppressed until confirmed.
ben_billing: PR merged and rolled back emitter batching change (deployed). monitoring pipeline for dropped envelopes.
alice_sre: emitter pods restarted, consumer lag decreasing: partition lags now ~120k total. recovery progressing (~95% catch-up in progress).
eva_recon: reconciliation complete (initial pass): remaining delta ~0.8% (~150,000 tokens) across backups — scheduled targeted backfill overnight to eliminate residuals.
carla_support: customer comm scheduled for 14:30UTC: apology + proactive credit offer for affected accounts. legal + trust reviewed copy.
derek_oncall: closing ops loop for now — postmortem owner: ben_billing, ETA 24h for RCA + mitigations (will post in #postmortems). great cross-team response. :thumbsup:
ben_billing: noted. I'll include deploy gating for emitter encoding, add unit and integration checks around flush boundaries, and improve metric alerting on emitter flush_delay.
incidents-bot: update logged: incident acked, temporary mitigations applied, fix deployed, recon delta within acceptable range. will auto-close thread when postmortem is posted.
